# Block-level DRC repair (EvoDRC dispatch)

This case is routed through the EvoDRC pipeline. The per-leaf prompt is built in-memory by `agent/src/prompt_format.py:build_leaf_prompt` and dispatched as ONE `claude -p` per leaf. This file's only job is to carry case_info into `agent.py` so that `agent/src/agent_entry.py` can parse it and run the pipeline.

<!-- EVODRC_CASE_INFO -->
```json
{{INFO_JSON}}
```
<!-- /EVODRC_CASE_INFO -->

## What EvoDRC does (informational; no LLM action required at this top level)

1. Parse `path_to_layout_script` and `path_to_drc_report` into in-memory geometry.
2. Split block-level violations into ~N cell-equivalent leaves using HRD recursive Stoer-Wagner min-cut.
3. For each leaf, dispatch ONE `claude -p` call with a self-contained context (per-leaf prompt is constructed by `agent/src/prompt_format.py:build_leaf_prompt`).
4. Validate the returned patch JSON with a 4-check pure-Python validator (provenance / mount feasibility / crop not empty / connectivity intact).
5. Mount valid patches, atomic-write the patched layout to `output_path`.
